Aisha (PM): Legal asked for GA stance on 99.9% "successful token emission" SLA for Dedicated/Private. We need a concise product position.
Ben (Infra): short answer: technically feasible with warm pools + prepull, but costs rise. need explicit measurement and exclusions.
Clara (DevEx): measurement proposal: rolling 30d successful_token_rate = tokens_returned / tokens_requested, per-customer. Exclusions: scheduled maintenance, customer misconfig, DDoS.
Diego (Support): support readiness: runbook, templates, and L2 training. owner and two backups required.
FinOps Bot: cost estimate: ~+10-13% committed GPU-hours for a 10-12% warm baseline. propose pricing options: tiered SLA or flat uplift.
Aisha (PM): product proposal: default GA = 99.5% included, 99.9% as paid tier (warm-pool uplift or line item). Owners: Ben -> infra changes + canary; Clara -> SLA doc + console compliance panel; Diego -> runbook + comms. Drafts due Tue EOD.
Ben (Infra): config snippet for appendix: ```yaml
warm_pool_percent: 0.12
prepull_on_deploy: true
```
Clara (DevEx): console ask: per-customer SLA health metric, 30d CSV export, downloadable compliance cert. reduces disputes.
Diego (Support): I'll prep templates and schedule a 30-min L2 walkthrough after drafts land.
Aisha (PM): OK. include fallback behavior in SLA (reduced fidelity fallback chain) and credit calc for breaches. We target leadership sign-off next week.
